items.quote: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
items.claim: God covenanted with Abraham, Isaac, and Israel to multiply their seed as the stars of heaven and to give them a specified land as eternal inheritance
items.object: covenant of multiplication and land inheritance
